svg.title: One handler set, generated steps between adjacent versions
svg.desc: A v2025_01 get request is upgraded step by step to the implementation version v2026_01 and its response downgraded step by step; an adopt error raised for a v2025_06 client is mapped by a hook; mechanical steps are generated, non-mechanical steps are required hooks.
svg.text: One handler set, generated steps between adjacent versions
get from a v2025_01 client: upgraded one step at a time, handled once, downgraded one step at a time.
unknown value or missing header -> resolver hook (aliases, account pin, default) -> typed 400 by default
required hook: trait method without a default body
Adding a removal that needs a value later adds a hook method; the build fails until it is implemented.
